articleTitle: Intelligent Self-Healing Control Strategy for Active Distribution Network Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The distribution network(DN) as the terminal network of the power system is the main approach to absorb distributed generation(DG), such as distributed photovoltaic(PV). The current distribution protection and automation system cannot satisfy the growing demand of DG. In this paper, an intelligent self-healing control strategy for active distribution network is proposed based on 5G technology, which can realize rapid self-healing of DN after a fault through distributed communication between key nodes. Finally, the real-time simulation platform based on RTDS is built, and the test results indicate that different faults lead to different self-healing process. Therefore, the experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling the Cleaning of Electricity Spot Market by Coordinating the Benefit Improvement of All Parties in the Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The participation of renewable energy in the clearing of the electricity spot market requires consideration of demand side response and coordination between energy storage. To ensure the improvement of market benefits among multiple entities, optimization research should be conducted on the traditional clearing strategy of the electricity spot market. Considering the benefits of all parties involved in the clearing stage, incorporating the adjustment needs of different peak valley differences in the power grid into the bidding process, and proposing a spot trading system that considers the allocation of income from the generation, network, load and storage side; To ensure low-carbon operation of the system, carbon emission trading on the energy supply side is considered, and an optimization model for electricity spot market clearing based on the coordination of benefits among the energy supply side, energy storage side, power grid side, and demand side is established. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model are verified through numerical simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Research and Verification of Resonant Deicing Mechanism on Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of ice and snow on distribution lines in winter, a resonant deicing method for distribution lines was proposed, and the simulation and experiment were carried out. Firstly, the finite element analysis software ABAQUS was used to conduct modal analysis of the 5mm, 8mm and 10mm ice-coated thickness conductor, and the natural frequencies of each order of ice-coated conductor were obtained. Secondly, the deadweight model simulation of the icing wire was carried out. Finally, the external excitation resonant frequency required for deicing was determined according to the equivalent stress and natural frequency, and the excitation simulation under different icing thickness was completed. Based on the simulation, a vibration deicing device based on resonant deicing mechanism is designed and developed, and the deicing experiment is carried out on the simulated conductor. The experimental results show that the deicing frequency is close to the simulation results, which realizes real-time monitoring of the icing thickness and control of the vibration deicing device to meet the deicing requirements of distribution lines.

articleTitle: Research on Suppression of Rotational Speed Fluctuation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Hall Signal Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper improves the existing rotor information estimation methods and the fault-tolerant operation methods for sector position errors. To transfer the advantages of the closed-loop model-based estimation method to the model-free estimation method, the existing interpolation-based method is mapped from the field of numerical fitting to the field of control. By introducing the closed-loop method, the suppression efect of this control system on noise and disturbances is enhanced, while maintaining its model-free characteristic. On this basis, in order to achieve fault-tolerant drive control and sector position error identification of the Hall sector position error in low-end scenarios, by reconfiguring the sectors of the multi-Hall sensor system, fault-tolerant operation and control of the Hall sector position error that can be directly driven without “preprocessing” are achieved, while maintaining the model-free feature to support its practical application value in large-scale applications in low-end scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Low Power Factor Standard Device Based on Sampling Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the proposal and implementation of the national "dual carbon" goals, the power system dominated by traditional power generation methods is gradually transforming into a new power system dominated by new energy, and low power factor is one of its typical characteristics. This paper mainly focuses on the application scenarios of low power factor in power systems, studies the power measurement standard device based on the sampling method, and proposes a wide-band voltage divider, a wide-band shunt and a dual-channel vector voltage analyzer device and a method for accurate phase measurement. A wide-band resistor divider and a squirrel cage shunt are used in this paper, and the phase error of the dual- channel vector voltage analyzer is experimentally analyzed. The overall system provides a high-precision measurement method for complex scenarios of power detection under low power factor.

articleTitle: Research on Topology and Control of Independent Controllable Phase Separation Hybrid Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The Hybrid Distribution Transformer (HDT) combines the main winding of a power frequency transformer used for voltage conversion with a power electronic converter. HDT can utilize the controllable capacity of the converter to achieve other functions while performing voltage conversion. One of the main functions of HDT is to solve the power quality problems of loads. The current power quality issues in the distribution system are reflected in the fact that the three phases are not completely identical. Therefore, the phase independent and controllable power quality management method is more suitable for the current distribution system. The phase separated independent controllable hybrid distribution transformer (SHDT) proposed in this article uses three single-phase converters to solve the power quality problems of each phase separately. Considering the different solutions to voltage and current issues, the mode switching switches are adopted to change the series parallel connection relationship of the converter, achieving two types of compensation functions while independently controlling the phase separation. Based on theoretical analysis, the function of phase independent compensation and the effect of mode switching were verified in the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Insurance Risk Engineering Application through Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper investigates the insurance risks associated with overhead transmission towers exposed to high-speed winds in specific regions and estimates the corresponding insurance premium. The study focuses on engineering insurance, an essential tool for mitigating potential losses and ensuring the solvency of insurance companies. Despite its significance, the practical application of engineering insurance remains limited. To address this gap, the paper employs the Monte Carlo Simulation method to predict the reliability of transmission towers under extreme weather conditions. By estimating the expectation of claims with simulation methods, the study calculates the potential loss and determines the minimum premium required to maintain the insurance company's solvency. The knowledge gained from this study can inform decision-making processes, strengthen infrastructure, and enhance the overall stability of insurance companies operating in the engineering insurance domain.

articleTitle: Design of Semiconductor Laser Drive Circuit Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: A circuit using STM32 chip as the main control is designed to address the issue of semiconductor laser performance being easily affected by injection current and operating temperature. It can achieve high-precision and high stability constant current drive and constant temperature control, and has complete protection functions. The system adopts LT3080 The AD5160, TS5A3159 chips and sampling resistors have been designed with a constant current negative feedback circuit; Design a constant voltage limiting module using LM317 chip to ensure that the forward voltage of the semiconductor laser does not exceed the rated maximum value, and the slow start module slowly increases the current to the set value; The electrostatic protection circuit effectively avoids the damage of high-voltage static electricity and surge current to the laser; Design a temperature sampling module with ADN8834 as the core, and use incremental digital PID technology to control the heating or cooling of TEC. The experimental results show that this driving circuit can continuously adjust the current of the semiconductor laser, with a range of 0 to 100 mA. The current regulation accuracy has reached 0.01mA, and the stability has reached 0.02%; The temperature control accuracy within 10–40 °C is 0.01 °C, and the stability can reach 0.12%.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Optimal Scheduling of CSP, PV, Wind, and Thermal Power Plants Using a Fuzzy Chance-Constrained Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In the day-ahead optimization of large-scale new energy power plants connected to a power grid, the scheduling decision are challenging due to the uncertainty of power outputs caused by weather. To address this uncertainty, this paper introduces a fuzzy chance constraint theory based approach, which employs fuzzy parameters to model the load and power output of new energy power plants, including concentrated solar power (CSP) plants. By transforming the deterministic scheduling model into a fuzzy chance constraint model, the system constraints are adjusted to fuzzy parameters. The proposed model considers the output fluctuations ofwind, photovoltaic (PV), and CSP plants, as well as the uncertainty in load demands. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through a case study. The numerical results demonstrate that the proposed fuzzy chance constraint model can reduce the reserve capacity of the system while optimizing the economics benefits and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Study on Force Calculation of Preformed Helical Fittings for Overhead Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In recent years, the preformed helical fittings in several UHV transmission lines have been scattered, deviated and broken, which affects the safe operation of the whole overhead transmission line system. Therefore, it is necessary to study the fastening characteristics of preformed helical fittings and conductors or earthwires. In this paper, according to the fastening characteristics between performed armor rods and earthwire, the stress calculation of preformed helical fittings for transmission line is carried out. Based on the explicit solution method of quasi-static analysis, the performed armor rods and earthwire are modeled by finite element method, and the time step of load loading, the force of performed armor rods and earthwire system are analyzed by parametric design method. The calculation results show that with the increase of time step, the tension loading rate decreases gradually, and the dynamic effect of the system also decreases. The kinetic energy of the system and the ratio of kinetic energy to internal energy gradually decrease, and the decreasing range tends to be flat.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of F/V Conversion System Based on Beidou Time Frequency Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the maturity of the Beidou satellite navigation system, Beidou's application in the power system continues to expand and deepen. The Beidou satellite navigation system can provide reliable spatio-temporal information services for power systems, especially new metering systems based on Internet technology. Aiming at the errors in the voltage-balanced frequency-to-voltage conversion process, an error calculation method based on signal chain analysis is proposed. The signal chain is classified and the error at each level is analyzed to calculate the overall error of the system, and the overall error is limited to a certain range through design. An operational amplifier error model based on feedback factor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex> is proposed. The model obtains analysis capabilities through the feedback factor. Taking AD652 as an example, this paper expounds the working principle of a charge-balanced frequency-to-voltage converter, focuses on analyzing the principle errors during the conversion process and the errors generated by the device, and finally gives the theoretical errors between the frequency-to-voltage conversion process and the result.

articleTitle: Grid-Forming Control Strategy of Photovoltaic-Energy Storage Based on Multi-Constraint Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: As the integration of renewable energy sources becomes more prevalent, the operation and control of power systems are facing unprecedented challenges. This paper addresses the issue of frequency fluctuations within photovoltaic-storage grid-connected systems by proposing an enhanced grid-forming control strategy that operates under a variety of constraints. The strategy involves the dynamic adjustment of the inertia time constant based on real-time monitoring of the energy storage system's state of charge and solar irradiance levels, thereby achieving dynamic optimization of the system's inertial characteristics. The effectiveness of the proposed enhanced grid-forming control strategy was confirmed through simulations conducted on the Simulink platform. The results of these experiments demonstrate that the new strategy significantly outperforms traditional grid-forming control methods in terms of frequency stability and dynamic response, particularly under varying lighting conditions and fluctuations in the state of charge.

articleTitle: An Improved Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control with Common-Mode Voltage Reduction for Four-Level Nested Neutral-Point Clamped Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This article introduces an enhanced finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) technique that allows for reducing common mode voltage (CMV) in a four-level inverter. At the same time, this approach lessens the workload on the computer, lowers harmonic currents, and maintains balanced flying capacitors (FC) voltage levels. Initially, after examining all potential voltage vectors in a four-level NNPC system, 20 voltage vectors with high CMV are eliminated, while the remaining vectors are chosen as potential voltage vectors for the suggested scheme. Next, in different sectors of the space vector graph, different PWM modes are adopted according to the difference of selected vectors. The combination of five-segment and seven-segment wave is adopted, which not only reduces the CMV, but also improves the current quality. Finally, the FC voltage is balanced by the selection of redundant switching states. The effectiveness of the proposed FCS-MPC method is confirmed through simulations.

Author Keywords: finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC)

articleTitle: Analysis of Actual Travel Energy Consumption of Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In-depth research on the travel characteristics and energy consumption patterns of plug-in hybrid electric vehicles plays a positive role in optimizing the performance of hybrid systems and improving overall vehicle energy efficiency. This study selected five private cars in Hangzhou for actual travel data collection and innovatively proposed an energy consumption analysis method based on the engine energy contribution. By subdividing travel units and defining the engine energy supply ratio, the energy consumption under different modes was analyzed. The results show that most trips are short distances, and half of the travel units are in a critical SOC state, reflecting the characteristic of PHEV users in Hangzhou being not active in charging. In different modes, the proportion of engine energy output to total energy consumption is positively correlated, indicating that while the engine increases the driving range, it also increases the level of on-road energy consumption. This analysis also helps manufacturers better understand consumers' actual usage patterns, facilitating further improvements in vehicle design that align more closely with market and environmental demands.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis of Wind Farm through HVDC Transmission System Considering Commutation Overlap Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: LCC-HVDC is vital for efficiently transmitting large-scale wind power over long distances. However, integrating substantial wind power into the AC grid can weaken the grid's strength, leading to stability issues when the LCC-HVDC sending end is connected to such a weak grid. Traditional models often overlook the rectifier side transformer's leakage inductance and the non-instantaneous commutation process, potentially skewing stability analysis outcomes. To address this, we approximate the commutation current as linearly varying to simulate the actual commutation process and employ a 3-D Fourier transform to develop an LCC-HVDC transmission admittance model that accounts for this phenomenon. By integrating the model with the direct-drive wind farm admittance and grid impedance, and using the equivalent SISO impedance conversion method, an integrated system impedance model is established. The influence of LCC commutation overlap on system stability is analyzed by an example, and verified by PSCAD simulation model.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimal Scheduling of CCHP Microgrids with Accounting and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Toward solve the difficulty of electricity consumption during peak periods, a coordinated and optimal scheduling model for combined cooling, power microgrids, and heating incorporating demand-side response was proposed. The methodology involves several key steps: initially constructing a microgrid model with constraint planning, then integrating a demand-side response model. CPLEX is employed to solve the problem, and an example is presented to illustrate how demand response effectively lowers electricity consumption during peak periods and smooths out demand fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on DC Breakdown Properties of HVDC Cable Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: As DC transmission has been used widely, HVDC cables are the development direction of power grid in the future. Because of space charges accumulating in XLPE insulation, DC breakdown properties are different from AC breakdown properties. Three kinds of DC cable insulation materials were selected in this paper. Breakdown tests with step by step voltage increase mode were used to study breakdown properties. Finally, the approximate formula of life index was deduced and analyzed. The results showed that breakdown strength of DC materials were related to test temperature and step time. The higher test temperature and longer step time, the lower breakdown strength. Shape parameters of DC materials were related to step time. The longer step time, the larger shape parameter. Life index of DC materials were related to the test temperature. The higher test temperature, the lower life index. Breakdown strength of DC material B was highest at room temperature and lowest at 70°C, while life index of B was lowest at room temperature and highest at 70°C. Therefore, both breakdown results and life index should be taken into account in cable insulation life evaluation.

articleTitle: Fault Section Location Method for Distribution Network Based on Combination of Magnetic Field and VMD-HHT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: When a single-phase grounding fault takes place in a non-effectively grounded system, the fault current is feeble and the fault characteristics are not distinct. This paper explores the magnetic field distribution beneath overhead lines and its relationship with three-phase currents to address the challenges of section location in current distribution networks. A non-contact fault location method based on magnetic fields is proposed. First, the orthogonal dual-axis magnetic field signals are synthesized, and then the synthetic magnetic field undergoes Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) to obtain its corresponding frequency components. Subsequently, the highest and lowest frequency components are processed using the Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT). Construct instantaneous energy criteria for the highest frequency component and instantaneous polarity and phase criteria for the lowest frequency component. A multi-criteria localization method based on microscopic instantaneous feature quantities was constructed from the perspectives of instantaneous energy, instantaneous phase, and instantaneous polarity. Tests were conducted in an ungrounded system, and the results showed that the method has accurate positioning results and strong feasibility.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Optimization Operation Method Considering Extreme Uncertainty Scenario
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Under the dual-carbon target, the proportion of new energy in the distribution network has increased significantly. This paper presents an optimal operation strategy for distribution network under extreme uncertainty scenario. Firstly, for the uncertainty at both ends of the source load of the distribution network, we use the scenario method to effectively characterize the uncertainty. We generate scenarios through a stochastic simulation method, and use the reverse scenario reduction technique to achieve scenario reduction and screen out extreme scenario. Subsequently, based on the extreme scenario data, we constructed a distribution network optimization operation method considering extreme uncertainty scenario and adopted an improved particle swarm optimization to improve the computational efficiency. Taking the IEEE 33-node system as an example, the results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Faulty Feeder Detection Under High Impedance Faults for Resonant Grounding Systems Based on Empirical Wavelet Transform and Synthetic Voting
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the line cannot be accurately selected when a high-resistance fault (HIF) occurs in a resonant grounded distribution system, by analyzing the impedance of the zero-sequence network, it can be concluded that within the characteristic frequency band, the current amplitude of the healthy feeder is smaller than that of the faulty feeder, and the current phase of the healthy feeder is opposite to that of the faulty feeder. Therefore, a high-resistance fault line selection method for a resonant grounding system based on empirical wavelet transform (EWT) is proposed. Firstly, the EWT algorithm is used to extract the transient current in the characteristic frequency band accurately. Secondly, the characteristic energy ratio, characteristic mutual correlation coefficient, and characteristic integral area are constructed for the transient current to measure the energy, phase, and polarity of the transient current. Finally, the high-resistance fault line selection is accurately realized according to the principle of “the minority obeys the majority”. Different types of high-resistance arc fault conditions are tested in a radial resonant grounding system with distributed generations (DGs). The test shows that the method has good adaptability and can correctly select the line under high-resistance faults.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Induction Motors Based on D-Axis Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In high-performance vector control systems for induction motors (IM), accurate parameters are essential for precise torque control. This paper aims to reduce the complexity of parameter estimation implementation and enhance the accuracy of parameter estimation. In this paper, an induction motor parameter identification method based on d-axis signal injection is proposed. First, without modifying the basic framework of the vector control system, four different d-axis injection methods are employed for parameter estimation. Next, the influence of the excitation branch in the equivalent circuit is considered, improving rotor resistance identification accuracy and reducing sensitivity to injection frequency. Additionally, a comprehensive parameter identification scheme is developed by optimizing the sequence of signal injections. Finally, a series of experiments is conducted to verify the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Voltage and Frequency Control Coordination Strategy of Wind-PV-ESS System for Black-Start
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In blackout scenarios of new power systems, wind farms (WF) and photovoltaic power stations (PVS) configured with scaled energy storage system (ESS) can be used as sources to support the black-start of thermal power units. Aiming at the disturbance of system voltage and frequency during black-start, a voltage and frequency control coordination strategy of Wind-PV-ESS system for black-start is proposed. The voltage control strategy includes normal control mode and correction control mode. When the bus voltage keeps within the limit, the former coordinately distributes the reactive power of each WT and PVA to maximize the dynamic reactive power reserve. After the bus voltage is disturbed beyond the limit, the latter makes full use of the fast dynamic reactive power response characteristics of SVG and ESS to provide voltage support. In the frequency control strategy. the reference power generated by the PI controller is allocated according to the proportion of the reserve power of each wind turbine (WT) or photovoltaic array (PVA) to the total reserve to eliminate the frequency deviation. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on LLC Resonant Converter Based on “Wedge” Shape Flat Winding Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel wedge flat winding with thin inside and thick outside improve the current distribution on the flat winding, reduce the loss of transformer. At the same time, as the distance between windings increases, the parasitic capacitance of the transformer will also become smaller. In this paper, the conductivity formulas of two kinds of windings are given first, then the eddy current loss calculation formulas under Dowell model are given, and then the parasitic parameter capacitance model of transformer is given. Finally, Maxwell software was used to simulate the current density distribution, loss and distributed capacitance of the two flat winding for simulation verification. The novel wedge shape flat vertical winding current density distribution is more uniform, and the copper wire utilization rate is higher. At the same time, a 96kHz/ 1152W LLC resonant converter prototype was used to verify the load efficiency of the wedge shape winding under different loads. The efficiency of wedge-shaped flat winding in transformer is higher than that of traditional flat vertical winding, which proves that the performance of the new wedge-shaped winding is better than that of traditional flat winding.

articleTitle: Strategic Offering of a Wind Power Producer in Energy and Green Certificate Markets: a Stochastic Bilevel Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy and the execution of renewable portfolio standards, it becomes urgent to analyze the behavior of a wind power producer (WPP) in energy and green certificate markets. To this end, we propose a strategic offering model for a WPP, aiming to analyze the impact of exercising market power on market clearing results and social welfare. Afterwards, the model is transformed into stochastic mathematical programming with equilibrium constraints (MPEC) and eventually mixed integer linear programming (MILP), which can be solved by off-the-shelf solvers. Finally, case studies are carried out on a small test system, illustrating that the market clearing price might increase compared with the perfect competition situation, and the expected profit of WPP increases at the expense of market efficiency. Besides, we analyse the impact of line congestion on the revenue of WPP.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Switching Behavior of Gate Oxide Degradation for SiC MOSFETs in a Phase-Leg Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: SiC MOSFETs exhibit reduced junction capacitance and enhanced switching speed when compared to Si-based MOSFETs, while maintaining the same withstand voltage. Nevertheless, the device's rapid switching operation is highly susceptible to the deterioration of the oxide layer, which accelerates the drift of the threshold voltage and hampers the device's efficient functioning. The analysis focused on the impact of SiC MOSFETs on turn-on loss, crosstalk, and turn-on overvoltage between phase angles, taking into account the aging of the oxidation layer. It is found that the turn-on speed of the device will be reduced after aging, the switching loss will be increased, and the influence of crosstalk and turn-on overvoltage will be weakened. The experimental results confirm the accuracy and efficiency of the inference analysis, which can offer valuable help for the design of active drive and condition monitoring of SiC MOSFETs.

articleTitle: Research on Three-Phase Voltage Unbalance Compensation Control Strategy of Flexibly Interconnected Distribution Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the large-scale access to distributed generations (DGs) and the diversified development of loads, the three-phase voltage unbalance in distribution areas is becoming more and more prominent. It brings challenges to the safe and stable operation of distribution areas. By virtue the power electronic equipment, the mutual power support among distribution areas, the consumption of DGs and the demand for high-quality power supply can be achieved with flexible interconnection devices (FIDs). Firstly, the structure, the mathematical model and the operation mode of FIDs are presented in this paper. Then, the three-phase voltage unbalance compensation control strategy is proposed based on the FID mutual power support function. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation and the hardware-in-loop experiment on StarSim.

articleTitle: Research on a Sensorless Control System for Dual-Branch Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with a Nonlinear Observer Based on Parameter Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The strongly coupled dual-branch motor adopts a multi-winding structure, where each phase of the motor has two sets of stator windings. This configuration reduces the capacity requirement of a single inverter and provides high fault tolerance. Based on the unique structure of the strongly coupled dual-branch motor, an isolated interleaved parallel driving strategy is employed, along with control algorithms such as carrier phase-shifting, to suppress high-frequency PWM noise at multiple carrier frequency multiples. To further enhance the reliability and control accuracy of this motor, this paper introduces parameter identification algorithms and sensorless control algorithms. For the motor's unique structure, the observer structure is reconstructed on the basis of a nonlinear flux observer, achieving sensorless control of the strongly coupled dual-branch motor. Simultaneously, the recursive least squares method is used for parameter identification of the motor. Finally, a parameter identification sensorless system is constructed based on the carrier phase-shift control of the strongly coupled dual-branch PMSM driven by an isolated interleaved parallel topology. Simulations demonstrate that the rotor position of the motor can be accurately observed at medium to high speeds, and the motor parameters can be obtained, advancing the control algorithms for the strongly coupled dual-branch motor.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Robust Planning Method for Microgrid Considering Flexibility Supply-Demand Balance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The microgrid plays an important role in regulating flexible resources as an aggregator of multiple types of distributed resources. To deal with the source-load uncertainty in the microgrid, a two-stage robust flexibility resource capacity allocation model is developed to obtain the optimal resource planning and scheduling scheme under the worst-case scenarios. Firstly, the uncertainty set on the source-load side is proposed through the forecast deviation, and the uncertainty regulation parameters are introduced to flexibly adjust the conservativeness of the scheme. Secondly, the interval method is adopted to portray the flexibility demand of the microgrid, and the system flexibility supply is modelled by analyzing the flexibility resource regulation characteristics. Then the flexible resources capacity allocation optimization model is established in order to achieve the system flexibility supply-demand balance. The planning scheme is solved by the Columns and Constraints Generation algorithm (C&CG). Finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by a microgrid case study, and the planning results achieve the balance between the economy and flexibility of the microgrid.

articleTitle: On Source-Network-Load Multi-Body Economic Operation Planning Strategy Considering Transmission Blockage
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to improve the economic efficiency of multiple subjects of source, network and load and give full play to the role of nodal tariff signals under the spot market of electricity, a kind of optimization strategy for economic operation planning of multiple subjects of source, network and load taking into account transmission blockage is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of the relationship between the source, network and load participating in the spot trading of the power market, the relationship between the nodal tariff position signal and the influence of the “source, network and load” multiple subjects is elaborated. Secondly, the node price and its volatility are introduced as the evaluation index of transmission blockage, and on this basis, the multi-principal economic benefit calculation model with the goal of optimizing the comprehensive benefit is constructed. Finally, a typical 6-bus 14-machine node model is utilized for simulation and analysis to establish a typical scenario of transmission blockage occurring in power spot market transactions, and to study the impact of node tariffs on the economic benefits of multiple main bodies of the source network and load under the power spot market. The simulation results show that the node tariff location signal can judge the line blockage, form optimization strategies, and guide the power supply side to reasonably plan the energy supply and the grid side to reasonably plan the investment in the planning stage of the power market operation, so as to reduce the cost of electricity and improve the efficiency of the load side of the electricity, which in turn provides a scientific basis for the enhancement of the comprehensive economic efficiency of the source network and load multi-body.

articleTitle: Hopf Oscillator-based Matching Control and Analysis in Isolated Inverter-Dominated Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In this paper, a Hopf oscillator-based weakly nonlinear oscillator is proposed to present its electromagnetic model, and then the matching control analysis framework is given from viewpoint of large-scale power system level. As internal core, the Hopf oscillator considers angular frequency and voltage amplitude as inputs, and it is used to emulate sinusoidal waveforms of electromagnetic transients. Correspondingly, approximated analytical solution of the oscillator and precise control are derived. Furthermore, angular frequency as output is generated by inertia motion, and voltage amplitude is emulated by virtual generator exciter. On this basis, the matching control framework is presented including inertia and primary controls and so on. Finally, the proposed control and matching approaches are verified by employing isolated IEEE 9-bus power system with 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> grid forming inverters.

articleTitle: Research on a High Voltage Isolated Resonant DC/DC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The input is alternating current (AC) and the output is direct current (DC) with adjustable positive and negative in the field of energy storage, vehicle charging, programmable power supply and other fields. AC input and DC output are generally isolated for security reasons. This paper adopts a three-stage topology to achieve this function, the front stage is a PWM rectifier circuit to achieve AC to DC conversion, the intermediate stage is an isolated Step-down circuit to achieve isolation, and the back stage is an H-bridge inverter circuit to achieve positive and negative bi-directional output. The topology of intermediate high voltage isolated resonant DC/DC circuit is introduced. The working mechanism and main parameter selection design of the soft switch are analyzed and calculated in detail. A 200W experimental prototype is developed and the correctness of the circuit design is verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy System Comprising a Coal-Fire CHP Unit with Deep Peak Shaving Retrofits
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: A method for introducing several thermoelectric decoupling modifications and finding the optimal operation in an integrated energy system (IES) containing combined heat and power units (CHP) is presented in this paper. Firstly, in order to achieve the effective consumption of clean energy, several means of deep peak shaving retrofits, such as low-pressure cylinder excision modification, high- and low-pressure steam bypass modification, addition of an electric boiler, addition of a heat storage tank, are evaluated. The safe operation feasible domains and decoupling capabilities of these means are compared. Secondly, an equipment model was established based on the principles of cogeneration units and several decoupling modifications, and the optimal operation was solved with multiple energy flow balancing as the limiting condition for and the lowest daily operating cost as the objective. Finally, the simulation results show that the optimal operation method can achieve the lowest single-day operation cost, and all the thermoelectric decoupling retrofits introduced in the integrated energy system can reduce the proportion of wind and light abandonment and the single-day operation cost.

articleTitle: General Softstart Strategy of Bi-Directional Buck/Boost by Feedforward Control Based on Average Current Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The buck/boost converters are widely used in bidirectional power flow application. High inrush current exists in the start-up process by traditional control strategy due to the loss of voltage second balance when both sides are voltage sources. In this paper, a general soft-start strategy of buck/boost in continues current modulation and triangular current modulation by feedforward control based on average current mode is proposed, which guarantees the voltage second balance during the operation, and eliminates the inrush current during the soft-start process. The proposed control can also be adopted to improve both steady and dynamic performance. Finally, a 300W experimental prototype has been built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Two-Layer Distributed Control for Interconnected Microgrid Clusters Based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Electrical energy router (EER) has emerged as a novel solution for interconnecting multiple microgrids (MGs) due to their ability to provide multi-directional power control. However, the frequency and voltage decoupling between microgrids hinders the realization of flexible power distribution. Moreover, existing control methods struggle to meet the diverse and reliable operational requirements of the system. In this paper, a two-layer distributed cooperative control scheme for EER-interconnected microgrid cluster (MGC) is proposed, which combines the pinning consensus algorithm and linear active disturbance rejection control. The MGC-layer and MG-layer are introduced by extracting the consistency inequality of each distributed generation (DG) output and its corresponding derivative, respectively. On the one hand, the EER transmission power reference is dynamically generated to achieve global power sharing through the information interaction of each pinned DG. On the other hand, each unpinned DG achieves frequency and average voltage restoration, as well as power sharing within each MG through synchronization and tracking. Simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method and mitigates the adverse effects of uncertainties and disturbances on the system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Voltage Restorer Appied for Urban Rail Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: To solve the voltage sag problem in metro escalators, Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) for urban rail power supply system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the Dynamic Voltage Restorer designed in this paper draws energy from the DC traction network without additional energy storage elements, which solves the energy storage problem of the conventional Dynamic Voltage Restorer. Secondly, a single-phase full-bridge inverter circuit is used to achieve phase-independent voltage compensation so that various voltage sag can be handled. Thirdly, an improved proportional-resonant(PR) composite control strategy is selected to realize the voltage tracking of the DVR. Finally, A Hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform is used to conduct simulation experiments in this paper, and the simulation results show that the model proposed in this paper can accurately realize the effective compensation of voltage sag on the metro escalator and ensure the normal operation of the escalator.

articleTitle: The Effect of Residual Charges on the Discharge of the Long Air Gap with a Floating Conductor Under Positive Switching Impulse
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The discharge experiment of the long air gap with a floating conductor is an effective experimental method in power transmission and distribution engineering. In order to avoid the effect of residual charges on the experimental results, the operators need to ground all the experimental devices before each set of experiments according to the normative process, which causes an increase in work intensity of the operators and the time for experiment. In this article, the comparative experiment on the effect of residual charges on discharge parameters is carried out. The result indicates that the residual charges have a slight effect on the breakdown voltage, the maximum voltage deviation is only about 5.72%, and the position of the minimum breakdown voltage of the gap isn't changed. The results can contribute to simplifying the experimental operation and shortening the time without causing inaccuracies.

articleTitle: Challenges, Opportunities and Prospects of Gas Power Generation Playing the Regulatory and Supportive Role in the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: As the demand for regulatory and supportive power sources in the new power system increases, gas power generation is gaining more attention due to its flexible start-stop capability, fast response speed, and wide regulation range. However, in recent years, its full potential in the new power system is limited by problems such as resource constraints, lack of effective price transmission mechanisms, and insufficient self-reliance of core equipment. This paper analyzes the main factors currently constraining the development of gas power generation in China, outlines the future development trends of gas power generation, and proposes relevant prospects and suggestions on gas power generation supporting the flexible operation of the new power system.

articleTitle: Research on Switched Reluctance Type of Electromagnetic Speed Regulating Motor and its Torque Pulsation Suppression Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to solve the defects of switched reluctance motor, a new type of speed regulating motor, Switched Reluctance Type of Electromagnetic Speed Regulating Motor (SR-EMSRM), is adopted, which combines the advantages of both switched reluctance motor and electromagnetic speed regulating motor. SR-EMSRM combines the respective advantages of the electromagnetic speed regulating motor and switched reluctance motor.The overall structure includes an outer rotor and an inner rotor, which is driven by the prime mover as the outer rotor to rotate the inner rotor of the Switched Reluctance electromagnetic slip clutch (SR-EMSC). SR-EMSC is driven by an outer rotor.The simulation model and experimental platform of switched reluctance electromagnetic speed motor based on torque distribution function control are constructed, which suppresses the torque pulsation of the speed motor compared with the traditional current chopper control, and improves the stability and immunity of the system through fuzzy self-immunity control.

Author Keywords: Switch reluctance type of electromagnetic speed regulating motor

articleTitle: Influencing Factors Analysis of PV Hosting Capacity
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) is one of the most important renewable energy sources, and its accessible capacity is restricted by various factors. Present research focuses on considering influencing factors as constraints for evaluating PV hosting capacity (PVHC), few studies explore the effects of influencing factors. To compensate for the shortcomings of present research, the main work of this paper is as follows: First, a PVHC evaluation model is established, in which PV constraints and safety constraints are considered. In addition, the effects of influencing factors in evaluation model on PVHC are explored by binding constraints in different distribution systems. The influencing factors of PVHC are divided into temporal factors and non-temporal factors. By analyzing the effects of influencing factors, the strength and scope of constraints are explored. Studies have shown that temporal factors have a strong effect on PVHC, and some non-temporal factors have strong effects on PVHC.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Power Transmission Effect Industrial Chain Based on a Univariate Multiple Lag Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This study conducts an in-depth analysis of the upstream and downstream power transmission mechanisms in key industries within Specializd, Refined, Distinctive, and innovative (SRDI) “Little Giant” enterprises. Firstly, data preprocessing is performed to ensure data integrity and accuracy. Then, basic statistical analysis is conducted to understand the fundamental characteristics of the data. Finally, a univariate multiple-lag regression model is used to model four industries. The model results indicate a one-month lag transmission mechanism between the oil and gas extraction industry, metal products industry, and general equipment manufacturing industry, while a three-month lag transmission mechanism exists between the science and technology promotion and application services industry and the metal products industry. These findings provide valuable support for the rational allocation of power resources and the formulation of related policies in the future.

articleTitle: A Strategy for Eliminating the Effect of Rotor Position Error on Model Predictive Current Control for High Electrical Frequency PMSM
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$d-q$</tex> axis voltage component is affected by the change of rotor position, and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$d-q$</tex> axis voltage component changes obviously in one control period, especially for high electrical frequency permanent magnet synchronous motors (HEFPMSM). A novel control strategy for eliminating the effect of rotor position error on conventional MPCC for HEF-PMSM is proposed. Firstly, the effect of rotor position change on <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$d-q$</tex> axis voltage component is analyzed, which proves that compensation is necessary for HEF-PMSM. Then, a new prediction plant model is proposed in the static coordinate system, which takes into account the change of the back electromotive force (EMF). Meanwhile, the position of the rotor is compensated during one-step delay compensation and current prediction. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method in this letter is experimentally verified compared with the conventional model predictive current control (CMPCC).

articleTitle: In Situ Tin Doping to Enhance the Cycling Performance of 4.9 V LNMO Cathode Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: LiNi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.5</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (LNMO) cathode material has the advantages of high energy density (650 Wh/kg), high discharge voltage (4.7 V vs Li+/Li), low raw material cost, low pollution, and high lithium ion transmission efficiency. It is a potential high power, low cost cobalt-free lithium-ion battery cathode material. However, the capacity decline of LNMO during high voltage charge and discharge processes leads to short cycle life, which limits its wide application and commercialization. To address this issue, this article uses in-situ Sn doping to enhance the cycle stability of LNMO. By uniformly mixing acetate salts in stoichiometric ratio and using one-step spray drying method to prepare undoped and Sn-doped LNMO cathode materials, this study systematically investigates the structural changes, morphological characteristics, and electrochemical performance before and after doping. The capacity retention rates of Sn-doped LNMO materials after 350 cycles at 0.7C are 93.5% and 94.5%, respectively, significantly higher than the undoped 80.8%, indicating that in-situ Sn doping can significantly enhance cycle performance. This study demonstrates that the LiNi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.46</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.04</inf> electrode prepared by spray drying method, with its simple and straightforward synthesis process and excellent electrochemical performance, has the potential to become a high-performance lithium-ion batteries cathode material.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Energy Storage System in Distribution Network with a High Proportion of Distributed Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the increase of distributed energy access to the distribution network, the traditional optimal scheduling method combined with an energy storage system is difficult to give full play to the advantages of an energy storage system to cope with the high proportion of distributed energy penetration in the distribution network. Because it ignores the problems of distributed energy and load uncertainty and its methodology. Therefore, a new adaptive coordinated control method for distributed energy storage capacity is proposed in this paper. Firstly, this paper calculates the reactive power loss of energy storage after accessing a high proportion of renewable energy and sets power constraints to ensure power stability. Then, this paper takes the optimal voltage condition, the lowest access load and net power, and the optimal power adjustable range at the high proportion distributed energy access as the regulatory goals and realizes the adaptive coordinated control of the distributed energy storage capacity of high proportion distributed energy access. Experimental data prove that the proposed method has significant advantages in terms of control effect, and can realize efficient distributed energy storage control and ensure efficient distributed energy output.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Gain-Scheduling Proportional-Integral Control for Improving Alkaline Water Electrolyzer Dynamic
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the increased emphasis on improving fuel economy and reducing emission, alkaline water electrolyzers (AWEs) have emerged as very strong candidates to fulfill these targets. Conventional approaches use proportional-integral (PI) control systems to control the actual AWE power, which can result in dynamic performance degeneration when AWE temperature changes. Our approach uses fuzzy gain scheduling to determine appropriate gains for the PI controller based on the AWE's operating conditions. The improvements include elimination of the overshoots when AWE temperature drops as well as approximate 50% faster response and settling times in comparison with the conventional linear PI control approach. The improved performances are demonstrated through simulations and field experiments using the matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Distribution and Propagation Characteristics of Mechanical Vibration Signals in GIS Enclosure
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Mechanical defects constitute a significant proportion of failures in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) systems, thereby posing a substantial threat to the operational safety and stability of power grids. Vibration signals serve as key indicators of such mechanical defects, highlighting the significance of analyzing the distribution and propagation characteristics of mechanical vibration signals within the GIS enclosure. In this paper, a horizontal GIS busbar model, excited by a three-phase power frequency current source, is developed to perform steady-state electromagnetic field analysis, yielding the electromagnetic forces exerted on the enclosure. The results reveal that the metallic enclosure is subjected to periodically varying electromagnetic forces at a frequency twice that of the excitation source. These forces induce mechanical vibrations in the enclosure, and the vibration acceleration is most prominent at the midline nodes on both sides of the enclosure. A structural mechanics model of the metallic enclosure is then developed, and the sequential coupling method is applied to compute the vibration acceleration response to electromagnetic force excitation. Experimental investigations on an actual GIS system demonstrate that the amplitude at 200 Hz is the most prominent in the vibration signal spectrum at the disconnector location, while the abnormal components of the vibration signal undergo significant attenuation as they propagate. Furthermore, the vibration signals at the midline positions on both sides of the horizontal GIS surface are found to be the most distinct.

articleTitle: Research on Reducing the False Alarm Rate of External Breach Hazards in Online Monitoring System of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In this paper, through the analysis of the false alarm rate of the transmission online monitoring system, 5 end factors were found and analysed one by one, and finally the 5 end factors of ‘ high percentage of non-sample library machinery ’, ‘ large error of the nearest point of the conductor picture and machinery ’, ‘ large tilt of the clasp ’ were identified, and a countermeasure table of the main causes was formulated by using the ‘ 5W1H method ’, and combined with the previous successful experience, based on the dimensions of the concealed site We established a sample library, constructed a three-dimensional model of the site, calculated the nearest point between the wire and the machinery, and adopted the movable buckle as a countermeasure, successfully reducing the false alarm rate from 75% to 35.78%. [9]–[10]

articleTitle: Analysis of the Law of Refraction and Reflection of Fault Traveling Wave in Phase Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Through a large number of measured data, it is found that, the single-phase fault occurs on transmission line. the traveling wave of the fault phase is mainly composed of line-mode component, and the zero-mode component contained in it will not affect the detection and calibration of the fault traveling wave. However, the waveform of the two non-fault phase current waves is not exactly the same, and the wave shape is different from the fault phase. Therefore, the law of refraction and reflection of fault traveling wave in phase domain is analyzed, the expressions of fault initial traveling wave, fault point reflection wave and opposite bus reflection wave of non-fault phase current traveling wave are obtained. It is concluded that the reflection wave of the opposite bus in the non-fault phase current traveling wave is independent of the refraction and reflection of the transition impedance at the fault point. Based on this, the idea of fault location based on using fully the fault information contained in the non-fault phase and the comprehensive information of the three-phase current traveling wave is proposed, and the single-ended traveling wave reliable fault location of the transmission line is realized, and realizes the reliable distance measurement of the single end traveling wave of the transmission line.

articleTitle: A Method for Calculating the Adjustable Potential of Multiple Users in Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper describes a method for calculating the adjustable potential of multiple users in virtual power plants, taking into account market factors. This strategy utilizes multiple nonlinear regression to predict the responsiveness of multiple users participating in regulation in different market environments, and calculates the overall adjustability potential of multiple users based on the adjustability potential and market responsiveness of various resources covered by multiple users. The proposed method has high computational efficiency and fully considers the impact of market factors on the adjustable potential of users.

Author Keywords: long and short term memory model

articleTitle: Suppression Techniques for Conducted Emissions of Marine Multi-Stage Single-Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In this paper, the conducted emission (CE1Ol and CE102) in the electromagnetic compatibility design of Marine multistage single-phase inverter power supply exceeded the standard, and optimized control strategy and suitable filter design were used to make the power supply meet the requirements of CE1Ol and CE102, respectively. The test shows that these measures have remarkable effects on conducted emission.

articleTitle: Variable Duty Cycle Heating Strategy Considering Internal Inconsistency for Fast Self-Heating Lithiumion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Preheating batteries at low temperatures is an important approach to improve the environment adaptability of lithium-ion batteries, in which compound fast self-heating is an efficient method. However, current compound fast self-heating under a fixed duty cycle also leads to severe internal temperature uniformity problems, while there is still a lack of theoretical basis for temperature difference limitation within a cell during heating. To solve the problems, a layered electro-thermal coupling model is established at first. It is found that temperature uniformity leads to internal current inhomogeneity through internal resistance difference. Further, a dynamic temperature difference limitation is introduced based on the temperature characteristics of internal resistance, and a novel variable duty cycle heating strategy with internal inconsistency improvement is proposed. The results show that the relative internal resistance difference can be reduced from 43% to 30%, improving internal resistance uniformity by 30% with the same heating rate, which indicates better internal inconsistency than the fixed duty cycle strategy.

articleTitle: Automatic Verification of Smart Substation SCD Configuration and Virtual Terminal Blocks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In smart substations, there are many virtual terminal connections. Currently, the correctness of these connections is checked one by one manually, which not only requires a large amount of work but also makes it easy to miss or make mistakes, thereby posing safety risks to the operation and expansion of smart substations. This paper proposes an automatic verification technology for the information model of the secondary system of an intelligent substation, by building a typical expert database to realize automatic verification of SCD configuration files, virtual circuits, and differentiation, thus ensuring the safe operation of an intelligent substation.

articleTitle: Influence of Power System Resilience on Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In modern society, the power system is a key infrastructure, and its reliability is crucial to the normal operation of society. However, with the increase of risks such as natural disasters and network attacks, the traditional power system reliability analysis methods face new challenges. As an important means to deal with these challenges, improving the resilience of power system is gradually receiving attention. This paper aims to study the influence of power system resilience on its reliability analysis. By combing the basic concepts and evaluation indexes of power system resilience and reliability, the theoretical mechanism of the influence of power system resilience on reliability is analyzed. Finally, a combination of qualitative and quantitative research methods is used to verify the reliability improvement effect of resilient construction of power system through the analysis of selected cases. The results show that enhancing the resilience of the power system can significantly improve its reliability and reduce the outage time and fault range.

articleTitle: Demand Response Strategy for Household Energy Systems Considering Various Device Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper develops mathematical models for typical household devices in household energy systems, including interruptible, transferable, and reducible devices. Based on the models, a demand response strategy for a household is proposed to optimize the daily operating costs of the energy system, considering constraints like device sequence constraints, device operation time window constraints, device collision constraints and energy limitation constraints. Guided by time-of-use electricity pricing from the grid, the strategy effectively schedules various devices in the home energy system. Simulation results demonstrate that, by applying this strategy, the daily operating costs of a typical home energy system is significantly reduced while its operating efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Electric Field Distribution Characteristics of Submarine DC Cable in Offshore Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Since submarine cables do not require the construction of special bridges or tunnels, which may fulfil the demands of the large-scale open-sea energy transmission. Moreover, DC systems have the advantages of high capacity, low loss, long transmission distance, etc., which are the focus of the future development of offshore wind power transmission technology. This paper aims to research on the electric field distribution characteristics of submarine dc cable in offshore wind power system. In this paper, the simulation model of the submarine DC cable is established. In this simulation model, the full-scale space charge distribution characteristics of the submarine DC cable and soft joint were studied, and the electric field intensity distribution characteristics inside the cable joint under different working conditions were studied, laying the foundation for further structural design of high-reliability submarine DC cables.

articleTitle: Characterisation of Grid Short-Circuit Faults with Energy Storage Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With a large number of new energy power stations connected to the grid, the power quality of the grid will be affected, in this regard, through the grid-connected energy storage power station to suppress the intermittent new energy generation characteristics such as wind power, and large-scale energy storage power station access to the grid will also have an impact on the grid short-circuit current, this paper through the study of different ways of grid-connected storage power station to obtain the short-circuit current of the output of the storage station in different ways to get with the grid type and structural grid type short-circuit current differences in the output of the storage power station. This paper investigates the different ways of grid-connected energy storage plants, obtains the output short-circuit current of energy storage plants under different control methods, gets the difference between the output short-circuit current of grid-following-type and grid-forming-type energy storage plants, and then obtains the short-circuit fault characteristics of the grid containing energy storage plants, and builds a simulation model and a short-circuit current calculation program under MATLAB/Simulink with a certain localized power grid of Shanxi Province, to verify the theoretical accuracy.

articleTitle: Transformer Economic Life Assessment Considering Time Value
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper proposes an evaluation method for the economic life of transformers, which takes the maximum annual net income as the optimization objective. By comparing the annual net income under two scenarios, maintenance and replacement, a decision is made whether to apply maintenance or replacement. Through analyzing various economic factors and patterns within the transformer's life cycle, including power supply income, various actual costs, risk costs, etc., mathematical models for annual net income are established for both maintenance and replacement scenarios. Empirical research results show that the model is highly operable, and the prediction results are in line with reality, which is of practical significance for power grid enterprises to achieve lean management of power equipment operations and to reasonably extend the life of transformers.

articleTitle: High-Impedance Fault Detection Method of Resonant Grounding Systems Based on the Polarity Difference of Transient Zero-Sequence Currents
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: To address the issue of the current distribution network's difficulty in accurately and quickly detecting single-phase high-impedance grounding fault (HIF) in lines, a method for detecting HIF in Resonant Grounding Systems based on the polarity difference of transient zero-sequence currents is proposed. By representing the nonlinear arcing high impedance through a segmented linear equivalent of the voltage-current characteristic curve during HIF, an analysis of the fault characteristics is conducted. Based on this, it is determined that the transient components of the faulty feeder and the healthy feeder have opposite polarities during a HIF. Subsequently, each feeder's zero-sequence current is subjected to low-pass filtering within the characteristic frequency band. The first extremum point is assigned a value, and an extremum point matrix is established. Finally, HIF detection is achieved through polarity characteristics.

articleTitle: Sequence Admittance Model Decoupling Method for Grid-Connected Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Impedance method is one of the classical methods for system stability analysis. In order to simplify the complexity of the model, it usually ignores the anti-diagonal elements of the sequence impedance matrix. However, the asymmetric control structure of the converters will lead to frequency coupling. When the frequency coupling is serious, ignoring the anti-diagonal elements will cause a large error. In this paper, the converter sequence admittance matrix considering phase-locked loop(PLL) and control system is established in d-q frame, and the reason of frequency coupling phenomenon is analyzed. Then, based on the characteristics and the constraints of the admittance matrix, the transfer function of the converter in the full band decoupling is solved, and the low and middle band decoupling method is designed. Finally, a simulation model in MATLAB verifies that the decoupling method of middle and low frequency band can effectively eliminate the frequency coupling, and the results of the sequence impedance method are consistent with the generalized Nyquist criterion after decoupling, which can accurately judge the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Admittance Modeling and Control Parameter Analysis of DC-Side Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The stability issues of novel power systems with obvious power electronic characteristics are becoming increasingly severe. In order to better analyze the transient stability of the system, it is necessary to built a more accurate mathematical model of the Voltage Source Converter (VSC) in High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems. This paper incorporates the impact of DC voltage fluctuations into the relationship between the modulation signal and the DC-side voltage, establishing a more accurate global state-space small-signal model for VSC-HVDC systems. This model is used to analyze the impact of control parameters on the system's transient stability and tune the control parameters. Finally, simulation models and small-signal calculation models of the VSC-HVDC system are built in PSCAD/EMTDC and Matlab, respectively. The simulation results of the two are compared to verify the accuracy of the established model.

articleTitle: Resilience Assessment and Enhancement for Distribution Network by Hydrogen Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Distribution networks are susceptible to hurricanes that cause widespread power outages. Resilience reflects the ability of distribution networks to withstand disasters, minimizing fault losses and restore power as soon as possible. Therefore, it is crucial to assess and enhance the resilience of distribution networks under hurricanes. This paper focuses on the distribution system, utilizing hydrogen trucks to sustain critical loads during hurricanes, and evaluates the system's resilience through the lens of power shortages as a resilience index. First, a hurricane is simulated and a distribution network fault model is constructed to quantify the impact of the hurricane. The Monte Carlo method is used to generate fault scenarios and determine the scale of the fault. The resilience assessment method is proposed and the resilience index is calculated; The hierarchical load shedding and the hydrogen transportation restoration contingency measures are designed. Case studies are conducted in the IEEE 33 node system to evaluate its resilience. The results show that transporting hydrogen to restore critical loads based on microgrid islanding operation can improve the resilience of the whole system in face of hurricane damage.

articleTitle: Management and Application of New Energy Measurement Modeling Data Based on State Grid Simulation Data Platform(PSDB)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper expounds the data modeling technology of high-proportion renewable energy power system and its application in the State Grid Simulation Data Platform (PSDB). Firstly, the whole process management methods of measured modeling, model review and model application of new energy power generation system are studied, and the development and deployment of new energy measured modeling data management system are completed. Secondly, based on the State Grid Simulation Data Platform (PSDB), the data modeling requirements of new energy stations with different simulation accuracy are analyzed, and the data push and display method of new energy models are designed and implemented. At present, this method has been used in PSDB to support the preparation of simulation data for grid operation mode calculation.

articleTitle: A Study on Low-Carbon Dispatching of Multi-Microgrid Cooperative Game Considering Carbon-Green Certificate Joint Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to realize the low-carbon economic goal of multi-microgrid system, this paper proposes a cooperative game low-carbon dispatching model for multi-microgrid system considering carbon-green certificate joint trading. Firstly, the carbon emissions trading and green certificate trading are considered comprehensively to establish carbon-green certificate joint trading model; Secondly, combining Nash negotiation theory to consider carbon-green certificate joint trading into a cooperative game low-carbon scheduling model for multi-microgrids, and the model is solved by the improved ADMM algorithm, which can effectively ensure the fair distribution of benefits among multi-microgrid system, protect the privacy of each participant and improve the convergence speed. Finally, the case shows that the proposed model can realize the energy-saving and carbon-reducing utility of the multi-microgrid systems, while guaranteeing the distribution of benefits of each participating subject.

articleTitle: The Study on the Design and Protection Configuration of Building PEDF System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Aiming at the application of PEDF technology in buildings, the design points of building PEDF system, including topology structure, voltage level and energy storage configuration are analyzed, and the corresponding protection configuration is studied.
